svg.title: Figure 2 | Five-Step Collaboration Loop
svg.desc: Based on the official Quickstart relationship; Apply + Verify explicitly includes this lesson’s verification responsibility. Arrows show a suggested sequence. Correct documents when assumptions fail; return from Archive to Explore for the next change. These are not tool-enforced quality gates.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Propose a change and its requirements.
People review and correct the plan.
Implement, check, test and retain evidence.
Update current specifications and preserve history.
↶ Next change: return to planning and exploration
